title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica: Prima Aurora

alternative_titles.ja: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora

synopsis:
More than half a year has passed since Ave Mujica's comeback, and spring has arrived. The band's popularity continues to grow, while each member's individual activities are also gaining momentum. The next venue Sakiko proposes is a members-only masquerade ball.

What lies behind the intentions of the girl who swore to become a god...?

(Source: Official site, translated)
